In Opzioni → 🗓️ Giornate tipo puoi crear: In Options → 🗓️ Day templates you can create your own day models (e.g. «Work day» or «Recharge Sunday»): a timed schedule that removes decision fatigue and keeps you on course. Actions sort themselves by time: feel free to add an earlier activity, it will land in its place.
Dai una scadenza alle missioni important: Give important quests a deadline (the time is optional) and choose in Options → 🎮 Game how many reminders you want and how early. From the first reminder the card turns orange and a red dot appears on the nav bar; from the due day the card turns red. No surprises, no forgotten deadlines.
